items.title: Applied Materials vs. Nvidia: Which Tech Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: Nvidia's 55.6% net margin dwarfs Applied Materials' 24.7%, but one trades at a steep valuation premium while the other faces customer concentration risk.

items.title: Applied Materials vs. Broadcom: Comparing Sales Growth Trajectories for These Artificial Intelligence Companies
items.summary: Broadcom's revenue has more than doubled in two years while Applied Materials posted modest gains.

items.title: Applied Materials vs. Intel: Examining Revenue Growth Trajectories of These Artificial Intelligence Companies
items.summary: Applied Materials has posted three consecutive quarterly gains and now generates $9.1 billion in revenue, while Intel's operating margin sits at half that of its competitor.

items.title: Chip Stocks Break Through Ceiling As Sector Rebounds. Macom Is A Standout.
items.summary: The Philadelphia semiconductor index, known as SOX, rose for a fourth consecutive day on Friday, with a new batch of chip stocks leading the charge.

items.title: KLAC Gains From AI Infrastructure: Can It Outpace AMAT & ASML?
items.summary: KLA Corporation's AI-driven process-control demand is rising with 2nm, EUV, HBM and advanced packaging investments as rivals intensify competition.

items.title: Lam Research Climbs 5% as Chip Equipment Names Outrun the Sector; Applied Materials Rises 4%, KLA Corp. Gains 3%
items.summary: Chip equipment stocks are breaking away from the broader semiconductor pack on Friday, and the pattern of who is buying what reveals something specific about where money is flowing and why the tools layer keeps trading on its own terms.

items.title: Eisman Says Buy Micron And SK Hynix. “In This Knife Fight You Want To Be The One Selling The Knives”
items.summary: Steve Eisman thinks the real winners of the AI arms race are not the chip designers everyone is fighting over but the suppliers equipping both sides of the battle. Five stocks have already lapped Nvidia in 2026, and Eisman ranks them by who survives if the whole AI ecosystem cracks.

items.title: ASML Rides on Strength in Installed Base Business: Will it Sustain?
items.summary: ASML's Installed Base Management sales surge 31.8%, fueled by upgrades and a growing EUV fleet, but sustaining growth hinges on customer demand.
